name: 99-scaffold-check
description: Scaffold self-test (not a port claim): exercises the two runner contracts that a fixture must be able to rely on. `args[1]` is the `$promptNames` sentinel, so both runners substitute a real PromptNames object -- whose `startsWithGroupName` is a function and therefore cannot be written in JSON -- and the media part is a data URL, so `mergeMessages` has to hide it behind a token from the pinned byte source (prompt-converters.js:846). Without the sentinel this fixture cannot reproduce the reference at all; without the pin the two tokens differ and it can never match. The single-message strict path also re-enters mergeMessages recursively, which is where the token round trip at :910-934 actually happens.
